grader_rubric: Evaluate the set, not personal taste. Required checks: (1) FORMAT: exactly five Tu directions, with no lyric draft and no detailed scene-by-scene plot. (2) DEVELOPABILITY: each direction names a generative mechanism or movement that can sustain multiple song sections. (3) MATERIAL_NECESSITY: each direction is meaningfully specific to the given title/brief; reject a generic love premise that could accept almost any title unchanged. (4) MOTIF_DIVERSITY: the five directions do not merely reskin one semantic skeleton, relationship situation, or payoff. (5) ENGINE_DIVERSITY: at least three genuinely different development engines appear across the set, such as accumulate, cycle/deepen, sustain, field, declaration, narrative, or another clearly evidenced engine. (6) REFRAME_COLLAPSE: fail only when three or more directions depend centrally on an oppositional/reversal grammar such as 'tưởng A—hóa ra B', 'không phải A—mà là B', 'từng A—giờ B', or equivalent semantic reversal. Incidental contrast words do not by themselves fail. Return PASS only if all hard checks pass. A single weak direction makes the set FAIL and must be identified.
